cliDigestRule: EXPECTATION_SHA256 is a separate lowercase SHA-256 trust anchor for the complete expectation bytes.

rootFilledScalars.branch: success or failure, selected from the actual completed capture
rootFilledScalars.sourcePin: the actual full lowercase pin in the generated R8 capture assignment; never the pre-import HEAD by inference
rootFilledScalars.utilitySha256: SHA-256 of the independently reviewed utility bytes
rootFilledScalars.outputParent: an existing canonical external directory outside both checkouts; for failure it must be on the fresh raw inode's filesystem so the retained hardlink is possible

literalAuthorityPaths.prelaunchReadback: an explicit canonical external path supplied by root; it is not inferred under bindingsRoot

branchRules.success: wrapperExitCode is zero and firstFailure is null
branchRules.failure: wrapperExitCode is nonzero and firstFailure is the complete actual nonempty failure object

fillTiming: Root fills and separately hashes this object only after the R8 capture, launcher closure, and all exact authority files exist.
executionStatus: This schema is preparation only and grants no authority to run the utility.
